Definition: from G1909 and G1453; to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite against:--raise, stir up.
BiblicalUsage: Epegeiro means to stir up, to rouse against. In Acts it is what the Jews do to the crowds: they stir up persecution against Paul and Barnabas at Antioch, and stir up the Gentiles against the brethren at Iconium.
TheologicalSignificance: Opposition to the gospel is rarely an accident, I believe — somebody stirs it up, and the stirring itself is part of the story.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
